Package restaurantrush.entity

Class ComboMeal

java.lang.Object
restaurantrush.entity.MenuItem
restaurantrush.entity.ComboMeal
public class ComboMeal extends MenuItem
A combo made of two existing menu items.

Its preparation units are the sum of both components, and its price is 90% of their combined price, rounded to the nearest cent. For example, Salad + Pasta costs ($9.00 + $18.00) x 0.9 = $24.30 and needs 3 units.

A combo is made up of other menu items. It is also a MenuItem itself, so orders, the Chef and pricing treat it like a normal dish.
